_doc: Per-site profiles for agents/site-goals-tracker (moved out of agent code, SHOP-22). Storage config/site-goals-tracker-config.json deep-merges over this file (by_site.<site>.<key>); a site.yaml site_goals.goal_overrides block still merges over goal_overrides. Generic goals take their per-site target/description from goal_defaults; event_goals are the site's own per-event conversion goals, inserted after goal-total-conversions-30d.

conversion_sql.amazon-clicks: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM kitchen_click_events WHERE source = 'amazon' AND created_at > now() - interval '30 days'
conversion_sql.instacart-clicks: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM kitchen_click_events WHERE source = 'instacart' AND created_at > now() - interval '30 days'

aisleprompt.page_count_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM recipe_catalog WHERE COALESCE(is_active, TRUE) = TRUE

annotations.note: measurement correction: Safari-17 fleet removed — a Safari 17.0-17.2 bot fleet (one click per IP, 0% US) was 348 of 681 30-day and 326 of 378 7-day verified-human Amazon clicks; filtered from 2026-11-11. The step down to ~330 (30d) / ~50 (7d) is not a regression.

aisleprompt.label: AislePrompt

goal-total-conversions-30d.description: Total monetization-event clicks in the last 30 days, bots excluded. Sum of GA4 instacart-cart + verified human instacart-clicks + amazon-clicks. Per event: max(GA4 event count, first-party click rows that pass framework/core/human_clicks.py — no site bot verdict, no headless/automation UA, no stale-browser fingerprint, no datacenter IP, no Singapore headless traffic, on-site referer, <=20 clicks/IP/day).

goal-active-pages-count.description: Total active rows in main content tables (recipes for AislePrompt; products + articles + hardware for SpecPicks). Index of how much content is in the funnel.

event_goals.title: 30-day Instacart cart creates
event_goals.description: GA4 'instacart-cart' event count last 30 days. The money event for AislePrompt.

event_goals.title: 30-day Instacart button clicks — verified human
event_goals.description: Verified human Instacart button clicks, last 30 days: kitchen_click_events rows that pass framework/core/human_clicks.py (bots, headless UAs, stale-browser fingerprints, datacenter IPs excluded), or the GA4 event count if higher. Outbound-interest leading indicator. Raw row count is the raw-instacart-clicks-30d metric.

event_goals.title: 30-day Amazon affiliate clicks — verified human (AislePrompt)
event_goals.description: Verified human Amazon affiliate clicks, last 30 days: kitchen_click_events rows that pass framework/core/human_clicks.py (bots, headless UAs, stale-browser fingerprints, datacenter IPs excluded), or the GA4 event count if higher. Raw row count is the raw-amazon-clicks-30d metric. Step changes from filter updates are noted in the goal's annotations.

event_goals.title: 7-day Amazon affiliate clicks — verified human (Cyber Week target 180)
event_goals.description: Verified human Amazon affiliate clicks over the trailing 7 days, same framework/core/human_clicks.py filter as goal-amazon-clicks-30d (first-party only). The value recorded on 2026-12-01 is Cyber Week (11-25 to 12-01). Baseline: 111 in the week to 2026-10-20. Target: 180 that week, with no dead answer pick on the nine top-click guides.

conversion_sql.amazon-clicks: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM outbound_clicks WHERE target = 'amazon' AND clicked_at > now() - interval '30 days'
conversion_sql.ebay-clicks: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM outbound_clicks WHERE target = 'ebay' AND clicked_at > now() - interval '30 days'

specpicks.page_count_sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE is_active = true) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM editorial_articles WHERE status = 'published') + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hardware_specs)
specpicks.label: SpecPicks

goal-total-conversions-30d.description: Total monetization-event clicks in the last 30 days, bots excluded. Sum of verified human amazon-clicks + ebay-clicks (JS beacon rows). Per event: max(GA4 event count, first-party click rows that pass framework/core/human_clicks.py — no site bot verdict, no headless/automation UA, no stale-browser fingerprint, no datacenter IP, no Singapore headless traffic, on-site referer, <=20 clicks/IP/day).

goal-active-pages-count.description: Total active rows in products + editorial_articles + hardware_specs. Index of catalog and content depth.

event_goals.title: 30-day Amazon affiliate clicks — verified human (SpecPicks)
event_goals.description: Verified human Amazon affiliate clicks, last 30 days. Counts outbound_clicks JS-beacon rows (via='beacon', never the /r/ redirect twin) that pass framework/core/human_clicks.py: not flagged is_bot, no headless/automation UA (HeadlessChrome, puppeteer, playwright, selenium, curl, python…), no stale-browser fingerprint, no datacenter IP (incl. Tencent/Alibaba/Huawei Singapore ranges), no Singapore traffic, an on-site referer, and <=20 clicks per IP per day — or the GA4 amazon_click count if higher. Primary revenue source for SpecPicks. The raw row count (~99% bots) is the raw-amazon-clicks-30d metric.

event_goals.title: 30-day eBay affiliate clicks — verified human
event_goals.description: Verified human eBay affiliate clicks, last 30 days (same human_clicks.py filter as the Amazon goal), or the GA4 ebay_click count if higher. Retro-marketplace revenue for SpecPicks. Raw row count is the raw-ebay-clicks-30d metric.
